source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #257 (branch fix/186-operand-stack-reserve at commit e13eaf7a43a3bcf1f39e1eaded3d767ce294cd44, the merge of main 9b4d3f3c4e5d65407796399251c639937090b918 into the PR head 862bbe2db450ceaa82115de0f2356a83f2aa8170; ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45072019203 and 45072026952 against the branch and pull-request run 45071971685, which built the same merge tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #257 (#186, reserve validated max operand depth at frame entry). The PR computes the validated maximum operand depth at parse time in pipeline::optimize_function from the type checker’s stack snapshots (the original stream’s fold; on the pipeline path the maximum of that fold and the reachable CanonFunc blocks’ fold), stores it as LoweredFunction.max_operand_bytes carried into CallRecipe, checks frame_end + bound <= stack length once at frame entry on every frame-construction path (overflow still traps StackOverflow, only detected earlier), and removes the per-push bounds checks from the seven _fast push functions (push_u32_fast / push_u64_fast / push_u128_fast, push_copy_from_ptr, local_get{4,8,16}_from_base) in crates/telomere/src/common/stack.rs, each of which now carries a debug_assert and the reservation invariant it relies on; checked pushes remain on non-frame paths (embedder staging, scheduler resume, host in-place results). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main (9b4d3f3) alone (workflow_dispatch run 45072035005): it reproduces the previous baseline exactly on all 28 gated series, so every delta is this PR’s own. The baseline configuration, which links no library code, is byte-identical in both profiles (4 of 28 gated series unchanged). Every library configuration shrinks in both profiles, because the _fast pushes are inlined into handlers across the library and their removed checks outweigh the single entry check and the added field: release stripped file -1,720..-4,568 B and stripped .text -2,096..-3,824 B; release-size (opt-level z, fat LTO, one codegen unit) stripped file -7,248..-8,160 B and stripped .text -4,320..-5,216 B. No series grows, so the gate passed on the merged tree before this re-baseline; the baseline is updated anyway so the recorded numbers keep tracking the code on main. Run-to-run spread was again 0 B for every gated series (14 profile/configuration rows x stripped file and stripped .text, n=3), so each threshold equals its observed baseline exactly (baseline + 0). Any further growth requires an intentional re-baseline; see docs/benchmarks/footprint.md, ‘Size regression gate (#164)’.
